question: What is the percentage of patient who has a abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase level, yet he or she is diagnosed with SLE?
evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to GOT > = 60; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(COUNT(ID WHERE GOT > = 60 AND Diagnosis = 'SLE'), COUNT(ID WHERE GOT > = 60)), 1.0);
clarification: Count each distinct CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN ID ELSE 0 END only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN T1.ID ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."GOT" >= 60
gold0: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN T1.ID ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`GOT` >= 60

b.request: What percentage of patients with GOT >= 60 are diagnosed with SLE, counting each distinct value of CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN ID ELSE 0 END only once, so that all non-SLE patients collapse into the single value 0?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN P.ID ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS percentage FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT >= 60
b.raw: What percentage of patients with GOT >= 60 are diagnosed with SLE, counting each distinct value of CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN ID ELSE 0 END only once, so that all non-SLE patients collapse into the single value 0?

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN P.ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT >= 60

d.request: What is the percentage of patients who have an abnormal glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase level (GOT >= 60) and are diagnosed with SLE, where the numerator counts each distinct patient ID only once, using CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN ID ELSE 0 END, among all patients with GOT >= 60?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN T1.ID ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
